title: Marry Me Chicken
description: Golden chicken cutlets simmered in a creamy tomato-Parmesan sauce with sun-dried tomatoes and basil. Rich, cozy, and quick enough for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.quantity: 3 large boneless skinless breasts, or 6 cutlets (about 2 1/4 pounds total)

steps.instruction: If using whole chicken breasts, slice each horizontally into cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Coat the chicken lightly in flour, shaking off the excess.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then reduce to medium and add butter.
Cook the chicken until golden on both sides, about 9 to 10 minutes total. Work in batches if needed, then transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to low and cook the garlic until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add tomato paste, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Cook until the tomato paste darkens slightly.
Add chicken stock and simmer until reduced by about half, scraping up any browned bits.
Stir in 1/2 cup cream and simmer gently until slightly thickened. Add Parmesan and sun-dried tomatoes.
Add more cream if desired and season the sauce to taste.
Return the chicken to the pan and warm through for about 4 minutes.
Remove from heat, top with fresh basil, and serve.
